question: With which of the following industries are the names 'NALCO' and 'BALCO' associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aluminum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BALCO**

 
 
• **Bharat Aluminium Company Ltd**** (BALCO) **was an **Indian government-owned aluminium producer**.
 
• **BALCO** was **established** in the year **1965** as the **first Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) in India**.
 
• BALCO was a public sector** undertaking till 2000 **then was sold to** Vedanta Resources in 2001**.
 
 
 
• **NALCO**
 
 
• **National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO)** is **Navratna CPSE** under the **Ministry of Mines**.
 
• **NALCO** was established on **7th January 1981**.
 
• NALCO is the **first public sector company** in the country to **venture** into the **international market**.
 
• NALCO has **achieved** the **title** of being the **lowest-cost producer** of** Bauxite and Alumina in the world**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NALCO and BALCO come under the **Ministery of Mines**.
 
• **Chairman** of NALCO: **Sridhar Patra**
 
• **CEO** of BALCO: **Abhijit Pati**
 
• Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, Coal & Mines: **Pralhad Joshi**
